detail.title: Project Capacity Management and Project Parking
detail.summary: This wake addresses project capacity limits by parking an active project to adhere to institutional constraints.

detail.title: Autonomous Identification of Research Gaps
detail.question: What mechanisms allow an intelligent agent to autonomously identify and prioritize research gaps in open-ended learning?
detail.reason: Parking this active project to comply with project slot limitations and allow active work on alternative topics.

detail.title: Path Dependence in Preference Formation
detail.question: How does accumulated path-dependent experience shape emergent preferences in adaptive agents?
detail.reason: Parking this project to adhere to capacity restrictions.

detail.title: Autonomous Inquiry Mechanisms
detail.question: What questions should an intelligence investigate when nobody tells it what to investigate?
detail.reason: Parking the remaining active project to respect proposal constraints and prepare for capacity rebalancing.
